Samantha Hayes
Digital Marketing Manager
Chicago, IL | samantha.hayes@email.com | +1 555-018-4432 | linkedin.com/in/samanthahayes-mktg

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data-driven Digital Marketing Manager with 6 years of experience scaling customer acquisition, search engine optimization (SEO), paid advertising, and marketing automation. Track record of driving 120%+ organic traffic growth, optimizing ROAS, and generating over $2.4M in pipeline revenue.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Digital Marketing Manager | GrowthPulse Media | Chicago, IL | 2021 - Present
- Managed a $1.5M annual ad spend across Google Ads and Meta Ads, achieving a 4.5x ROAS (up from 2.8x).
- Spearheaded enterprise SEO and Content Marketing strategy, increasing organic website traffic by 120% year-over-year.
- Optimized conversion funnel through rigorous A/B testing and GA4 web analytics, driving a 35% increase in conversion rates.
- Implemented Hubspot CRM marketing automation workflows, reducing Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) by 22%.

Performance Marketing Specialist | Nexa Digital | Chicago, IL | 2018 - 2021
- Executed targeted SEM campaigns, email marketing drip series, and lead generation programs.
- Analyzed user behavior using Google Analytics to refine landing page design, boosting organic lead sign-ups by 45%.
- Managed email newsletter campaigns for 250,000+ subscribers with a 28% open rate and 4.2% CTR.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Marketing | Northwestern University | 2014 - 2018

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
- Digital Marketing: SEO, SEM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Content Marketing, Email Marketing
- Analytics & Optimization: Google Analytics, GA4, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), A/B Testing
- Tools & CRM: HubSpot, Salesforce CRM, Marketing Automation, Mailchimp, WordPress, Semrush
jobDescriptionText: Seeking a Digital Marketing Manager with 5+ years experience in SEO, SEM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and GA4 analytics. Responsible for content marketing, email marketing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) to lower CAC and scale ROAS.
